name: Battle text
description: The battle's message box no longer stops the fight. Async: the action goes on while the text stays up for a moment (a new text replaces the old), and notes the animation already shows (a plain Attack, Evade, stance and gauge notes) are dropped. Skip: no message boxes at all. Damage, results and the rules are unchanged; the victory and defeat texts stay as they are.

options.name: Mode
options.description: Off: the game's own message boxes. Skip: none. Async: shown without waiting for a button.
